items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Scotty was the vocalist so he would pick the tunes.

ctx.x: We thought that they were in Kansas City making $100 a week. This is Depression! You see, and these people were asking for jobs; they heard our broadcast. We were on WOW. I was the first one to sing "All of Me" on the radio. Scotty was the vocalist so he would pick the tunes.
